costPart.description: Inferred from NILSSON-ASTAR-1968-AUTHOR-SCAN, section II.B, Equation (1) f(n) = g(n) + h(n): g is the actual cost of an optimal path from s to n, h the actual cost of an optimal path from n to a preferred goal node of n.
